cves.description: CVE records matching the filters, one row per CVE (2,000 a page, offset paging with startIndex).

keywordSearch.desc: words in the description (every word must appear)

keywordExactMatch.desc: true: keywordSearch is one exact phrase (a flag)

cpeName.desc: CPE 2.3 name of a product, e.g. cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*

virtualMatchString.desc: CPE match string with wildcards, e.g. cpe:2.3:o:microsoft:windows_10

cvssV3Severity.desc: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL (CVSS v3)

cvssV4Severity.desc: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL (CVSS v4; see traps)

cvssV2Severity.desc: LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH (CVSS v2, older CVEs)

pubStartDate.desc: published on or after (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601); needs pubEndDate, range at most 120 days

lastModStartDate.desc: modified on or after; needs lastModEndDate, range at most 120 days

kevStartDate.desc: added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on or after; needs kevEndDate, at most 120 days

kevEndDate.desc: added to the KEV catalog on or before

hasKev.desc: true: only CVEs in CISA's KEV catalog (a flag)

noRejected.desc: true (default): leave out REJECTED CVEs; false keeps them

isVulnerable.desc: true: with cpeName, only configurations marked vulnerable (a flag)

sourceIdentifier.desc: the CNA that published the record, e.g. secure@microsoft.com

cve_count.description: How many CVEs match the filters (one row: total_results), without downloading them. Same filters as cves.

pubStartDate.desc: published on or after; needs pubEndDate, at most 120 days

lastModStartDate.desc: modified on or after; needs lastModEndDate

kevStartDate.desc: added to the KEV catalog on or after; needs kevEndDate

kevEndDate.desc: added to the KEV catalog on or before

isVulnerable.desc: true: with cpeName, vulnerable configurations only

sourceIdentifier.desc: the CNA that published the record

enums.note: Verified live 2026-10-30: flags take no value (hasKev=true is refused with HTTP 404, hasKev or hasKev= works); each date pair needs both ends, full ISO 8601 date-times, and at most 120 days (kev pair too); severities are upper case; errors are HTTP 404 with the reason in a 'message' response header.
